name: Cross-Source Merge
description: Merges movies and series from several source folders into one library tree using symbolic links.
overview: Several source folders, one library: the plugin reads the sources, groups them by TMDB id, title and year and creates one folder per title holding one link per source.

versions.changelog: Configuration page fixed: a doubled comment end dropped the whole palette, so the page fell back to inherited grey and the marks turned invisible. Text colours are defined now. Mapped means an id is there - titles that exist only in a source no longer sit in "without mapping" for good, and a missing library title shows as its own mark. German leftovers are translated (Target tree, Backups, Work list, Detection, Writing, Search, Status, Target path).

First public alpha. Movies and series from several source folders are merged into one library tree using symbolic links; sources are tagged (1 Local, 2 Stream, 3 NAS) and duplicates of the same source are numbered. Categories are their own libraries, missing sources stay visible as a shadow library with placeholders, orphaned targets can be cleaned up. User interface and documentation are in English.
